questions.stem: I had never ____ a horse before last summer.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 온다. ride-rode-ridden이므로 ridden이 맞다. rode는 과거형이라 had와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: She had already ____ lunch when I called her.
questions.why: had + p.p. 형태이므로 eaten. ate는 과거형이어서 had 뒤에 올 수 없다.

questions.stem: We had ____ the movie before, so we chose another one.
questions.why: 과거(chose)보다 먼저 본 일이므로 had seen. saw는 과거형이라 had 뒤에 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: He had ____ his homework before dinner.
questions.why: had + p.p.이므로 do-did-done의 done이 맞다.

questions.stem: The children had ____ all the juice before noon.
questions.why: drink-drank-drunk이므로 과거분사 drunk가 had 뒤에 온다.

questions.stem: My brother had ____ to Jeju twice before he turned ten.
questions.why: '~에 가 본 적이 있다'는 have[had] been to이다. had 뒤에는 과거분사 been을 쓴다.

questions.stem: When I got to the bus stop, the bus ____ already left.
questions.why: 버스가 떠난 것은 도착(got)보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had left. 주절이 과거이므로 has는 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: By the time the guests arrived, Mom ____ already set the table.
questions.why: By the time+과거절이 있으므로 그보다 먼저 끝난 일은 과거완료 had set으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: Tom told me that he ____ his wallet on the bus.
questions.why: 말한 시점(told)보다 지갑을 두고 내린 일이 더 먼저이므로 대과거 had left를 쓴다.

questions.stem: The ground was wet because it ____ during the night.
questions.why: 땅이 젖어 있던 과거 시점보다 비가 온 것이 먼저이므로 had rained.

questions.stem: She ____ her homework before her mother came home.
questions.why: 엄마가 온 과거 시점보다 먼저 끝낸 일이므로 had finished.

questions.stem: I ____ never eaten Thai food before I visited Bangkok.
questions.why: 방콕에 간 과거 시점 이전의 경험이므로 had never eaten. 주절이 과거이므로 have는 어색하다.

questions.stem: When we entered the room, someone ____ the window.
questions.why: 들어간 시점보다 창문을 연 것이 먼저이므로 had opened.

questions.stem: He couldn't get in because he ____ his key at home.
questions.why: 못 들어간 과거보다 열쇠를 두고 온 일이 먼저이므로 had forgotten.

questions.stem: The children ____ soccer for an hour when it started to rain.
questions.why: 과거의 어느 시점까지 한 시간째 계속되던 동작이므로 과거완료진행 had been playing.

questions.stem: I ____ studying for two hours when my friend called.
questions.why: 전화가 온 과거 시점까지 두 시간 동안 계속된 일이므로 had been studying.

questions.stem: The baby ____ crying for ten minutes before his mom picked him up.
questions.why: 과거(picked)보다 앞선 시점부터 계속된 동작이므로 had been crying.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) The bell had already (ring / rung) when I came in.
(B) We had (see / seen) that show before.
questions.why: 둘 다 had 뒤이므로 과거분사 rung, seen을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) She said she had (lose / lost) her umbrella.
(B) They had (be / been) in the gym since two o'clock.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 오므로 lost, been이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) I had (write / written) my name on the paper.
(B) He (has / had) already gone home when I called.
questions.why: (A)는 had+p.p.이므로 written, (B)는 전화한 과거보다 먼저 간 일이므로 had이다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) The train (has / had) left before we got to the station.
(B) We had (take / taken) many pictures that day.
questions.why: before+과거절이 있으므로 (A)는 had, (B)는 과거분사 taken이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) My dad had (buy / bought) a new bike for me.
(B) She had never (be / been) abroad before 2019.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 오므로 bought, been이다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) The movie had already (begin / begun) when we sat down.
(B) I (didn't / hadn't) met him before that day.
questions.why: begin-began-begun이므로 begun, 그날 이전의 경험은 hadn't met으로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
When the class ① <u>began</u>, I ② <u>had</u> already ③ <u>finish</u> ④ <u>my</u> ⑤ <u>lunch</u>.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 finish를 finished로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
She ① <u>said</u> that she ② <u>have</u> ③ <u>seen</u> the movie ④ <u>two</u> days ⑤ <u>before</u>.
questions.why: 주절이 과거(said)이고 더 이전의 일이므로 have를 had로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
The dog ① <u>ran</u> away because someone ② <u>had</u> ③ <u>leave</u> the ④ <u>gate</u> ⑤ <u>open</u>.
questions.why: had 뒤이므로 leave를 과거분사 left로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
By the time we ① <u>got</u> home, Dad ② <u>had</u> ③ <u>already</u> ④ <u>cook</u> ⑤ <u>dinner</u>.
questions.why: had already 뒤에는 과거분사 cooked가 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
I ① <u>had</u> never ② <u>rode</u> a bike ③ <u>until</u> my father ④ <u>taught</u> ⑤ <u>me</u>.
questions.why: ride-rode-ridden이므로 rode를 과거분사 ridden으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
They ① <u>had</u> ② <u>been</u> ③ <u>wait</u> for the bus ④ <u>for</u> an hour when it ⑤ <u>came</u>.
questions.why: 과거완료진행은 had been+-ing이므로 wait을 waiting으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
He ① <u>told</u> us that he ② <u>had</u> ③ <u>broke</u> ④ <u>his</u> ⑤ <u>arm</u>.
questions.why: break-broke-broken이므로 had 뒤에는 broken을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
When I ① <u>arrived</u>, the shop ② <u>have</u> ③ <u>already</u> ④ <u>closed</u> ⑤ <u>for</u> the day.
questions.why: 도착한 과거보다 먼저 끝난 일이므로 have를 had로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: She had went to the library.
He had ate all the bread.
They had finished the work before noon.
We has left before the rain.
I had saw the movie twice.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 온다. went→gone, ate→eaten, has→had, saw→seen으로 고쳐야 하므로 ③만 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The party had already start when we arrived.
The party had already started when we arrived.
The party has already started when we arrived.
The party had already begin when we arrived.
The party had already starting when we arrived.
questions.why: had+과거분사 started가 맞다. ③은 과거(arrived)와 현재완료가 어울리지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
choices: He had wrote a letter to his teacher.
She had cleaned her room before dinner.
We had been friends for ten years.
They had left when I called.
I had lost my ticket, so I couldn't enter.
questions.why: write-wrote-written이므로 had wrote가 아니라 had written이어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 문장은?
choices: The rain had stopped before we went out.
They had took the last bus.
My sister had never been to a concert.
He had been reading for an hour.
I had already eaten when she came.
questions.why: take-took-taken이므로 had took이 아니라 had taken이어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 고르시오.
choices: By the time he called, I had already leave.
By the time he called, I have already left.
By the time he called, I had already leaving.
By the time he called, I was already left.
By the time he called, I had already left.
questions.why: By the time+과거절보다 앞선 일이므로 had already left가 맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>어색한</u> 것은?
choices: We had knew each other since 2015.
I had never seen snow before I moved here.
The bird had flown away when I opened the cage.
He had washed the dishes before he went out.
She had been waiting for me for an hour.
questions.why: know-knew-known이므로 had knew가 아니라 had known이어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
내가 도착했을 때 그는 이미 떠나고 없었다.
choices: When I arrived, he already leaves.
When I arrived, he had already left.
When I arrived, he has already left.
When I arrived, he had already leave.
When I arrived, he was already leave.
questions.why: 도착보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had already left.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
나는 전에 그 책을 읽은 적이 없었다.
choices: I have never read the book before.
I had never readed the book before.
I had never reading the book before.
I never had reading the book before.
I had never read the book before.
questions.why: 과거 이전의 경험이므로 had never read. read의 과거분사는 read이고 readed는 없는 형태이다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그녀는 숙제를 끝낸 후에 잠자리에 들었다.
choices: She went to bed after she had finished her homework.
She went to bed after she had finish her homework.
She went to bed after she has finished her homework.
She goes to bed after she had finished her homework.
She went to bed after she had finishing her homework.
questions.why: 더 먼저 일어난 일에 had finished를 쓰고 주절은 과거 went로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그가 왔을 때 우리는 두 시간째 그를 기다리고 있었다.
choices: We have been waiting for him for two hours when he came.
We had been waiting for him for two hours when he came.
We had being waiting for him for two hours when he came.
We were been waiting for him for two hours when he came.
We had been waited for him for two hours when he came.
questions.why: 과거완료진행은 had been+-ing이므로 had been waiting이 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그는 지갑을 잃어버려서 아무것도 살 수 없었다.
choices: He couldn't buy anything because he has lost his wallet.
He can't buy anything because he had lost his wallet.
He couldn't buy anything because he had lose his wallet.
He couldn't buy anything because he had lost his wallet.
He couldn't buy anything because he had losing his wallet.
questions.why: 살 수 없었던 과거보다 지갑을 잃어버린 일이 먼저이므로 had lost.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Why were you so hungry last night?
B: Because I ____ anything since morning.
questions.why: 과거의 어느 시점까지 계속된 상태이므로 hadn't eaten. since는 완료 시제와 함께 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Did you watch the show with Mina?
B: No. When I turned on the TV, it ____ already finished.
questions.why: TV를 켠 과거보다 프로그램이 끝난 것이 먼저이므로 had finished.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: You looked so tired yesterday.
B: Yes. I ____ for six hours before I got there.
questions.why: 도착한 과거보다 먼저 계속된 일이므로 had driven.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Was the cake still on the table?
B: No. Someone ____ it before I came home.
questions.why: 집에 온 과거보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had eaten.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ I had finish my lunch.
ⓑ She had gone home.
ⓒ They had been friends for years.
ⓓ He had saw the movie.
questions.why: ⓑ, ⓒ가 옳다. ⓐ는 finished, ⓓ는 seen이어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ The bus had already left.
ⓑ We had ate dinner.
ⓒ I had never met her before.
ⓓ She had been sleeping for two hours.
questions.why: ⓑ만 틀렸다. had ate가 아니라 had eaten이어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 한 단어로 쓰시오.
I had never ____ (see) a whale before that trip.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 온다. see-saw-seen.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 한 단어로 쓰시오.

questions.why: write-wrote-written이므로 had 뒤에는 written.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 한 단어로 쓰시오.

questions.why: fly-flew-flown이므로 과거분사는 flown.

questions.stem:

questions.why: eat-ate-eaten이므로 had 뒤에는 eaten.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 한 단어로 쓰시오.
He had ____ (break) the window before I got there.
questions.why: break-broke-broken이므로 과거분사는 broken.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 한 단어로 쓰시오.
We had ____ (take) many photos before it rained.
questions.why: take-took-taken이므로 과거분사는 taken.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 한 단어로 쓰시오.
My sister had ____ (go) to bed before ten.
questions.why: go-went-gone이므로 had 뒤에는 gone.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 한 단어로 쓰시오.
The boys had ____ (swim) in the lake before lunch.
questions.why: swim-swam-swum이므로 과거분사는 swum.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
She had <u>wrote</u> her name on the card.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사 written이 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
The show had already <u>began</u> when we arrived.
questions.why: begin-began-begun이므로 had 뒤에는 begun.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
I had never <u>rode</u> a horse before that day.
questions.why: ride-rode-ridden이므로 과거분사 ridden으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
He had <u>drank</u> all the water before the race.
questions.why: drink-drank-drunk이므로 과거분사 drunk로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
They <u>has</u> left before the rain started.
questions.why: 과거(started)보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
The children had been <u>play</u> outside for an hour.
questions.why: 과거완료진행은 had been+-ing이므로 playing으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
When I got home, my dog had <u>hide</u> under the bed.
questions.why: hide-hid-hidden이므로 과거분사 hidden으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
When I got home, my brother ____ already gone to bed.
questions.why: 과거(got)보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had+p.p.를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
She couldn't call me because she ____ lost her phone.
questions.why: 전화를 못 한 과거보다 폰을 잃어버린 일이 먼저이므로 had lost.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 과거완료(had+과거분사)로 바꿔 두 단어로 쓰시오.
Before we moved here, we ____ (live) in Busan for five years.
questions.why: 이사 온 과거보다 먼저 계속된 일이므로 had lived.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 과거완료(had+과거분사)로 바꿔 두 단어로 쓰시오.
The train ____ (leave) before we reached the station.
questions.why: 역에 도착한 과거보다 먼저 떠났으므로 had left.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 과거완료진행형(had been+-ing)으로 바꿔 세 단어로 쓰시오.
It ____ (rain) for two hours when we went out.
questions.why: 과거 시점까지 계속되던 동작이므로 had been raining.

questions.stem: The library was closed when we got there because it ____ two hours earlier.
questions.why: 문을 닫은 것이 도착보다 두 시간 먼저이므로 대과거 had closed. 주절이 과거라 has closed는 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: Sujin suddenly realized that she ____ her umbrella on the subway.
questions.why: 깨달은 시점(realized)보다 우산을 두고 내린 일이 더 먼저이므로 had left.

questions.stem: By the time we called the box office, all the tickets ____.
questions.why: By the time+과거절보다 앞서 완료된 일이므로 had sold out.

questions.stem: The police wanted to know who ____ the window the night before.
questions.why: the night before는 과거(wanted)보다 앞선 때이므로 had broken.

questions.stem: Mr. Kim moved to Seoul in 2020. Before that, he ____ in Daegu for ten years.
questions.why: 2020년 이사보다 앞선 기간이므로 과거완료 had worked.

questions.stem: When the fire fighters arrived, the flames ____ the whole roof.
questions.why: 소방관 도착(과거)보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had already reached.

questions.stem: I didn't recognize Mina at first because she ____ her hair since I last saw her.
questions.why: since가 있어 완료 시제를 쓰고, 기준 시점이 과거(didn't recognize)이므로 had dyed.

questions.stem: Nobody was surprised, because the coach ____ us about the change the week before.
questions.why: the week before는 과거(was surprised)보다 앞선 때이므로 had told.

questions.stem: Amy's eyes were red because she ____ for a long time.
questions.why: 과거 시점까지 오래 계속되던 동작이므로 과거완료진행 had been crying.

questions.stem: The road was covered with snow. It ____ since the night before.
questions.why: 과거 시점까지 계속된 일이고 since가 있으므로 had been snowing.

questions.stem: It was the first time that I ____ a foreign country.
questions.why: It was the first time+과거완료가 원칙이므로 had ever visited.

questions.stem: Emma had studied French for three years before she ____ to Paris.
questions.why: before절에는 나중에 일어난 일을 과거시제로 쓴다. 앞선 일에 이미 had studied를 썼다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) After she (had read / has read) the letter, she smiled.
(B) I knew that I (have met / had met) him somewhere before.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 기준 시점이 과거이므로 현재완료가 아니라 과거완료를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) The museum (has been / had been) closed for repairs when we visited last May.
(B) He told me that his family (moves / had moved) to Busan.
questions.why: 기준 시점이 과거(visited, told)이므로 (A)는 had been, (B)는 그보다 앞선 일이므로 had moved.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) They had been (drive / driving) for hours when the car broke down.
(B) By the time the bell rang, everyone (had left / has left) the classroom.
questions.why: (A)는 had been+-ing이므로 driving, (B)는 과거보다 앞선 일이므로 had left.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) When I woke up, the sun (had risen / had rose).
(B) She wondered where she (had put / had putting) her glasses.
questions.why: rise-rose-risen이므로 had risen, had 뒤에는 과거분사 put을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) The concert (had begun / began) already when we found our seats.
(B) He didn't pass the test because he (hadn't studied / hasn't studied) at all.
questions.why: 둘 다 과거보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 과거완료를 쓴다. 주절이 과거라 현재완료는 어울리지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) I lost the watch that my uncle (had given / has given) me.
(B) We had been waiting for an hour before the doctor (came / had come).
questions.why: (A)는 잃어버리기 전에 받은 것이므로 had given, (B)는 나중에 일어난 일이므로 과거 came.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
The house ① <u>looked</u> strange because the new owners ② <u>have</u> ③ <u>painted</u> it ④ <u>while</u> we ⑤ <u>were</u> away.
questions.why: 기준 시점이 과거(looked)이고 그보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 have를 had로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
When the movie ① <u>ended</u>, I ② <u>realized</u> that I ③ <u>had</u> ④ <u>saw</u> it ⑤ <u>before</u>.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 saw를 seen으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
Jina ① <u>couldn't</u> join us because she ② <u>had</u> ③ <u>been</u> ④ <u>study</u> at the library ⑤ <u>all</u> afternoon.
questions.why: 과거완료진행은 had been+-ing이므로 study를 studying으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
① <u>Before</u> the guests ② <u>came</u>, my mother ③ <u>had</u> ④ <u>cleaned</u> the living room and ⑤ <u>bake</u> a cake.
questions.why: had cleaned와 병렬이므로 bake를 과거분사 baked로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
We ① <u>were</u> surprised ② <u>that</u> the little boy ③ <u>had</u> ④ <u>learn</u> to play the piano ⑤ <u>by</u> himself.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 오므로 learn을 learned로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
The letter ① <u>had</u> ② <u>been</u> ③ <u>write</u> in French, so nobody in the room ④ <u>could</u> ⑤ <u>read</u> it.
questions.why: had been 뒤에는 과거분사가 오므로 write를 written으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
He ① <u>said</u> that he ② <u>had</u> ③ <u>never</u> ④ <u>ride</u> a roller coaster ⑤ <u>until</u> then.
questions.why: ride-rode-ridden이므로 had 뒤에는 ridden을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
① <u>After</u> the storm ② <u>had</u> ③ <u>passed</u>, the villagers ④ <u>begun</u> to ⑤ <u>repair</u> their houses.
questions.why: 나중에 일어난 주절의 동사는 과거시제여야 하므로 begun을 began으로 고친다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The train had already left when we have arrived at the platform.
The train has already left when we arrived at the platform.
The train had already left when we arrived at the platform.
The train had already leave when we arrived at the platform.
The train already left when we had arrived at the platform.
questions.why: 먼저 일어난 일(떠남)에 had left, 나중 일(도착)에 과거 arrived를 쓴 ③이 옳다. ⑤는 두 사건의 순서가 뒤바뀌었다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: After I had eaten dinner, I have washed the dishes.
After I eaten dinner, I had washed the dishes.
After I have eaten dinner, I had washed the dishes.
After I had eaten dinner, I had washing the dishes.
After I had eaten dinner, I washed the dishes.
questions.why: 먼저 일어난 일에 had eaten, 나중 일에 과거 washed를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
choices: We had been knowing each other for years.
I had lived in Jeju for two years before I came to Seoul.
He had been to Canada twice before he was fifteen.
The children had been playing outside before it got dark.
They had already gone home when the party ended.
questions.why: know는 상태를 나타내는 동사라 진행형으로 쓸 수 없다. had known each other로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞지 <u>않는</u> 문장은?
choices: Ann said that she had lost her ticket.
Ann said that she had wrote a poem.
Ann told me that she had gone to the doctor.
Ann said that she had never seen such a big fish.
Ann told us that she had been busy all week.
questions.why: write-wrote-written이므로 had wrote가 아니라 had written이어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장을 고르시오.
choices: It was the first time I have visited the temple.
It was the first time I had visit the temple.
It was the first time I had visited the temple.
It was the first time I visiting the temple.
It was the first time I had been visit the temple.
questions.why: It was the first time 뒤에는 과거완료 had visited를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것을 고르시오.
choices: By the time the movie ended, the baby had fallen asleep.
The garden looked lovely; someone had watered the plants.
I had been waiting for the bus for 20 minutes when it finally came.
When the teacher came in, the students have already opened their books.
She had finished her project before the deadline came.
questions.why: 기준 시점이 과거(came in)이므로 have를 had로 고쳐 had already opened로 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
우리가 그 식당에 도착했을 때, 그곳은 이미 문을 닫은 상태였다.
choices: When we got to the restaurant, it has already closed.
When we get to the restaurant, it had already closed.
When we got to the restaurant, it had already close.
When we had got to the restaurant, it already closed.
When we got to the restaurant, it had already closed.
questions.why: 도착보다 먼저 완료된 일이므로 had already closed를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
나는 그때까지 그렇게 아름다운 일몰을 본 적이 없었다.
choices: I had never seen such a beautiful sunset until then.
I had never see such a beautiful sunset until then.
I had never seeing such a beautiful sunset until then.
I have never seen such a beautiful sunset until then.
I had been never seen such a beautiful sunset until then.
questions.why: 과거의 그때까지의 경험이므로 had never seen을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그들은 결혼하기 전에 5년 동안 서로 알고 지냈다.
choices: They have known each other for five years before they got married.
They had known each other for five years before they got married.
They had knew each other for five years before they got married.
They had been knowing each other for five years before they got married.
They know each other for five years before they got married.
questions.why: 결혼(과거)보다 앞선 기간이므로 had known. know는 진행형으로 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 소년은 두 시간 동안 축구를 하다가 다리를 다쳤다.
choices: The boy has been playing soccer for two hours when he hurt his leg.
The boy had been played soccer for two hours when he hurt his leg.
The boy had been playing soccer for two hours when he hurt his leg.
The boy was been playing soccer for two hours when he hurt his leg.
The boy had being playing soccer for two hours when he hurt his leg.
questions.why: 과거 시점까지 계속된 동작이므로 had been playing.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
엄마는 내가 이미 설거지를 해 놓은 것을 아셨다.
choices: Mom knew that I have already washed the dishes.
Mom knew that I had already wash the dishes.
Mom was known that I had already washed the dishes.
Mom knew that I had already washed the dishes.
Mom knew that I had already washing the dishes.
questions.why: 아신 시점(knew)보다 먼저 한 일이므로 had already washed.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: How was the party?
B: I don't know. By the time I arrived, most of the guests ____.
questions.why: 도착한 과거 시점보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had left.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Why didn't you answer my call last night?
B: Sorry. I ____ asleep before nine.
questions.why: 전화가 온 과거보다 먼저 잠든 것이므로 had fallen asleep.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: The kitchen looked so clean yesterday.
B: Right. Dad ____ it before we came back.
questions.why: 돌아온 과거보다 먼저 끝난 일이므로 had cleaned.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: You knew the answer right away!
B: Yes, because I ____ the same question the day before.
questions.why: the day before는 과거(knew)보다 앞선 때이므로 had practiced.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• When we arrived, the show ____ already ended.
• She ____ been studying for two hours when I called her.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 기준 시점이 과거이므로 had가 공통으로 들어간다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• I ____ never tried Indian food before last year.
• They ____ lived in Ulsan for six years before they moved.
questions.why: 과거의 어느 시점 이전의 경험·계속을 나타내므로 둘 다 had가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ The bus had gone by the time we got there.
ⓑ She said she had finish the report.
ⓒ I had never been to a musical before that night.
ⓓ We had been walking for an hour when it began to snow.
ⓔ He had knew the truth all along.
questions.why: ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓓ가 옳다. ⓑ는 had finished, ⓔ는 had known이어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ After the rain had stopped, we went outside.
ⓑ The room was messy because nobody has cleaned it.
ⓒ Tom had lost his phone, so he bought a new one.
ⓓ They had been fish for two hours.
ⓔ I realized that I had left my bag on the bus.
questions.why: ⓑ는 had cleaned, ⓓ는 had been fishing이어야 한다. 나머지는 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ⓐ By the time she called, I have already gone out.
ⓑ He had been read the novel since morning.
ⓒ We had ate all the sandwiches before noon.
ⓓ The kids had fallen asleep before the movie ended.
questions.why: ⓓ만 옳다. ⓐ는 had already gone, ⓑ는 had been reading, ⓒ는 had eaten이어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 after를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (먼저 일어난 일은 과거완료로 쓸 것)
I finished my homework. Then I went out to play.
questions.answer: After I had finished my homework, I went out to play.
alt: I went out to play after I had finished my homework.
questions.why: 먼저 끝낸 일은 had finished, 나중 일은 과거 went로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 before를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (먼저 일어난 일은 과거완료로 쓸 것)
The students took their seats. Then the bell rang.
questions.answer: The students had taken their seats before the bell rang.
alt: Before the bell rang, the students had taken their seats.
questions.why: 앉는 일이 먼저이므로 had taken, 종이 울린 일은 과거 rang으로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
He said, "I lost my ticket."
questions.answer: He said that he had lost his ticket.
alt: He said he had lost his ticket.
questions.why: 전달동사가 과거이고 그보다 앞선 일이므로 lost를 had lost로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
She said, "I have finished the work."
questions.answer: She said that she had finished the work.
alt: She said she had finished the work.
questions.why: said(과거) 앞의 완료된 일이므로 have finished를 had finished로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 두 단어로 쓰시오.
The movie ____ (begin) before we got to the theater.
questions.why: 도착보다 먼저 시작했으므로 had begun. begin-began-begun.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 두 단어로 쓰시오.
Everyone ____ (leave) by the time the manager arrived.
questions.why: by the time+과거절보다 먼저 끝난 일이므로 had left.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 두 단어로 쓰시오.
Ann told me that she ____ (visit) the museum twice.
questions.why: 말한 시점(told)보다 앞선 경험이므로 had visited.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 과거완료진행형으로 바꿔 세 단어로 쓰시오.
They ____ (wait) for two hours when the train finally came.
questions.why: 기차가 온 과거 시점까지 계속된 동작이므로 had been waiting.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 과거완료진행형으로 바꿔 세 단어로 쓰시오.
It ____ (snow) all night, so the roads were white in the morning.
questions.why: 과거 시점 이전부터 계속된 동작이므로 had been snowing.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
She was upset because she had <u>forget</u> her lines.
questions.why: had 뒤에는 과거분사가 오므로 forgotten으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
The team had been <u>practice</u> for months before the match.

questions.why: 관객이 혼란스러워한 과거보다 먼저 바꾼 일이므로 had changed.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
A: How did you finish the project so fast?
B: Well, I ____ most of the research before the semester even started.
questions.why: 학기가 시작된 과거보다 먼저 끝낸 일이므로 had done.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• Hardly ____ we sat down when the fire alarm went off.
• I found that the town ____ changed beyond recognition since my last visit.
questions.why: 첫 문장은 Hardly 도치 구문의 had, 둘째 문장은 found보다 앞선 변화를 나타내는 had이다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
A: You looked upset yesterday.
B: I ____ my phone on the bus that morning, so I couldn't call anyone.
questions.why: 어제 속상했던 시점보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 had left.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 Hardly로 시작하는 도치 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
I had hardly stepped outside when it began to snow.
questions.answer: Hardly had I stepped outside when it began to snow.
questions.why: 부정어 Hardly가 문두에 오면 had+주어+과거분사로 도치되고 when절과 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 No sooner로 시작하는 도치 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
As soon as the manager left, the staff relaxed.
questions.answer: No sooner had the manager left than the staff relaxed.
questions.why: No sooner+had+주어+p.p. ~ than+과거: 먼저 일어난 일은 과거완료로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
She said, "I have already sent the email."
questions.answer: She said that she had already sent the email.
alt: She said she had already sent the email.
questions.why: 전달동사가 과거이므로 have sent를 had sent로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (시간 표현도 알맞게 바꿀 것)
He told me, "I finished the report last night."
questions.answer: He told me that he had finished the report the night before.
alt: He told me he had finished the report the night before.
He told me that he had finished the report the previous night.
He told me he had finished the report the previous night.
questions.why: 시제는 finished→had finished, 시간 표현은 last night→the night before로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Someone had stolen the bicycle before the police arrived.
questions.answer: The bicycle had been stolen before the police arrived.
questions.why: 과거완료의 수동태는 had been+과거분사이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (행위자는 생략할 것)
They had completed the tunnel by 1998.
questions.answer: The tunnel had been completed by 1998.
questions.why: 과거완료 수동태 had been completed를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 By the time으로 시작하는 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
The firefighters reached the building. The roof had already fallen in.
questions.answer: By the time the firefighters reached the building, the roof had already fallen in.
questions.why: 나중 일은 By the time+과거, 먼저 일어난 일은 과거완료로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 채우시오. (세 단어)
그들이 도착했을 때 나는 세 시간 동안 요리하고 있었다.
When they arrived, I ____ for three hours. (cook)
questions.why: 과거의 기준 시점까지 계속되던 동작이므로 과거완료진행 had been cooking.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오.
그가 문을 닫자마자 전화벨이 울렸다. (had / no sooner / he / the door / closed)
→ ____ than the phone rang.
questions.answer: No sooner had he closed the door
questions.why: No sooner가 문두에 오면 had+주어+과거분사 어순으로 도치된다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오.
그 편지는 내가 태어나기 전에 쓰인 것이었다. (been / had / written / the letter)
→ ____ before I was born.
questions.why: 과거완료 수동태는 had been+과거분사이다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
The committee announced that the project had <u>delayed</u> for financial reasons.
questions.why: 프로젝트는 지연되는 대상이므로 수동형 had been delayed로 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
We had <u>been knowing</u> each other for a decade before we started the company.
questions.why: know는 상태동사라 진행형으로 쓰지 않으므로 had known으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
No sooner had the ceremony ended <u>when</u> the guests headed for the buffet.
questions.why: No sooner는 than과 짝을 이룬다. (Hardly[Scarcely] ~ when)

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오.
Hardly <u>I had</u> put down the phone when it rang again.
questions.why: 부정어 Hardly가 문두에 왔으므로 had I put down으로 도치해야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 한 단어를 쓰시오.
• Hardly ____ the sun risen when the farmers went out to the field.
• The path was muddy because it ____ been raining all night.
questions.why: 첫 문장은 도치된 과거완료, 둘째 문장은 과거완료진행이므로 둘 다 had가 들어간다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 After로 시작하는 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (먼저 일어난 일은 과거완료로 쓸 것)
The doctor examined the patient. Then he changed the prescription.
questions.answer: After the doctor had examined the patient, he changed the prescription.
questions.why: 먼저 한 진찰은 had examined, 나중 일은 과거 changed로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 It was the first time으로 시작하여 같은 뜻으로 다시 쓰시오. (that과 과거완료를 사용할 것)
I saw a live orchestra for the first time that evening.
questions.answer: It was the first time that I had seen a live orchestra.
questions.why: It was the first time that+과거완료로 과거 그때까지의 첫 경험을 나타낸다.

questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (수동형, 세 단어)
The windows ____ (clean) before the guests arrived.
questions.why: 창문은 닦이는 대상이고 손님이 온 과거보다 먼저 끝난 일이므로 had been cleaned.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장을 before를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (과거완료진행형을 유지할 것)
The tourists had been standing in line for two hours. Then the gate finally opened.
questions.answer: The tourists had been standing in line for two hours before the gate finally opened.
questions.why: 계속되던 동작은 과거완료진행, 나중 일은 과거시제로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오.
내가 도서관에 도착했을 때 그 책은 이미 대출되어 있었다. (already / been / had / borrowed / the book)
→ When I got to the library, ____.
questions.answer: the book had already been borrowed
questions.why: 과거완료 수동태 had been borrowed 사이에 already를 넣어 had already been borrowed로 쓴다.
